title: Google Calendar Update Caused All Daily Itinerary Entries and Tasks to Disappear
body:
After updating the Google Calendar app, all of my daily itinerary entries, notes, tasks, and schedules disappeared or are no longer displaying properly.

Previously, I used the daily schedule view regularly to organise my plans, work, and personal notes, and everything worked fine before the update.

After the update:

* All entries appear to be missing
* Tasks and reminders disappeared
* Daily itinerary notes no longer show
* The new layout is difficult to navigate and use

I have already checked:

* Calendar sync settings
* Permissions
* Account login
* Hidden calendars

but the issue still remains.

Please investigate and fix this issue as soon as possible, as it has seriously affected my daily planning and schedule management.

Thank you.

Missing important function such as month view. The app shows a whole month without showing if there're events in days. And it's hard to open that view. 

Fancy animation used throughout but hard to navigate. It's hard to reach the top to close the event. It would be better if iOS navigation gestures are to be included.

Advance functions available on the web interface are missing. It would be good to duplicate event and move events to another calendar.

2). 建議可以加入Touch ID解鎖

3). 建議可加入到下拉式清單中

4). 另外顯示方面，我覺得好華麗...而且在清單顯示時下拉則可以顯示成個月份的小月曆，呢個非常正。但當我想睇再下面的清單是，那個小月曆就會隱藏番，請問可否在小月曆的右下角，新增「釘子」令我可以一路Scroll下面清單，一路都會顯示小月曆呢？

5).  假設我想Copy以往的標題，用作開設新約會，可以能夠像地址一樣，直接Copy到，而不用拉來拉去選取？甚至可以考慮Copy成個活動，然後直接新約會？

PS: 本人以實例話你知呢個功能有咩方便我。
因工作關係，我每天工作時都會去不同地點、公司工作...
假設我想Copy兩個月前去過的公司，我現在要先找尋那公司名，再Highlight 那間公司名，再選擇今天的約會，貼上名後新增，再返回兩個月前的紀錄，Copy地址多一次，再找回今天於地點再Paste...
author: hackentsui

title: 看不懂簡體字
body: 「假日」有部份是簡體字，有部份是繁體字，很混亂。請指引如何糾正設定為繁體字，謝。
author: dra-WiNG

title: Lack of important function
body: It's fancy but useless. The most user friendly function - month view doesn't provide. No reason to use this instead of Calendars 5.
author: 畢仔
